title: Aaradhane
desc: A priest performs sacred rituals and chants hymns, seeking blessings from the deity. The ceremony brings peace and devotion to all who witness it.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Aathma Bandhana
desc: After Vaishnavi is mercilessly killed by her in-laws, her spirit enters a doll which seeks revenge against everyone responsible for Vaishnavi's death.

title: Ganeshana Maduve
desc: Ganesha lives happily in a complex owned by Ramanamurthy. Things take a turn when he falls in love with Adilakshmi, the youngest daughter of Ramanamurthy who sings under the pseudonym Shruti.

title: Diggajaru
desc: A rich landlord and his servant bond well irrespective of their status. When the landlord accidentally commits a murder, the servant decides to take the blame on himself.

title: Yajamana
desc: Devi Shetty, a cruel gangster, is out to plunder a village's oil resources and ruin its inhabitants' livelihood. However, the son-in-law of the village head, Krishna, stands in his way.

title: Doddmane Hudga
desc: Surya, estranged from his wealthy family after being ignored by his father, returns years later to protect their land from a vile villain.

title: Dakota Express
desc: Owners of a bus, Krishna and Sundar, face numerous problems due to poor conditions. However, their life takes a turn when the daughter of the minister takes refuge in their bus.
